resource_rule.measure: Sum of libproc resident bytes rounded up per member to KiB over owned process group; sampled, not continuous peak
resource_rule.failure: Stop above 40 GiB, after three consecutive unavailable observations, or immediately after a sampler timeout; retain all partial evidence. Unknown native/group exit blocks every subsequent child.

semantics.schedule: graph seed; case; adjacent reference/multigraph children. Second graph seed reverses both case order and variant order. Native algorithm=(order+repetition)%5; five timed repetitions balance positions.
semantics.timing_boundary: Original native tuple interface and native return types. KKT/compactor input conversion and temporary input destruction timed; returned-result destruction and exact validation excluded. UTC and process CPU envelopes are slightly wider than steady elapsed.
semantics.certificate_scope: Independent native reference certificate once per child, then exact unique-MST ID/tuple validation for every warmup and timed call.
semantics.clock_semantics: Steady elapsed and process CPU remain separate. Clock flags are descriptive, never a reason to trim or correct data. UTC reversals remain in raw endpoints. Power-log correlation uses actual Sleep/Wake/DarkWake transitions; Wake Requests do not close sleep.
semantics.power_semantics: No verified sleep inhibition is inferred. An absent logged overlap is not proof of an awake, quiet host. Power auditing is post-capture only and never launches pmset automatically.
semantics.sampling_semantics: Variants share input and starting seed; different edge retention/order can change the internal RNG trajectory. This is a whole-implementation comparison, not a matched sampled-subgraph ablation.
semantics.comparison_aggregation: Variant case summary: median of ten paired trial ratios; graph summary: median of five ratios. Original per-variant KKT/competitor tables separately retain medians over repetitions, sampling seeds, then graph seeds.
